column1: # One row per code the toolchain emits: the code, a tab, and a one-line
# summary of what it refuses. Rows are ordered by family and then by number.
# This file is the source of truth. `foundation/app/Kira/Diagnostics.kira`,
# `tests/registry.rs` fails when a code is emitted that this file does not
# list, when this file lists one nothing emits, or when a generated artifact
# A `…` stands where the message interpolates a name, a type, or a count.
